Youtuber Dhruv Rathee Detained by Delhi Police

Youtuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by Delhi Police on Tuesday morning. Approximately 50 police personnel, reportedly in plain clothes, arrived at his residence in Gurugram. The specific reason for his detention and details of the case have not yet been released. Rathee was later seen in Delhi, commenting on police arrangements. Several CJP activists were also reportedly detained along with Rathee and taken away in buses.
